# Bendy SAO Middle build notes

I built another 10 sections of BendySAO by hand, here are my notes.

## Software

 * Added Attiny3224 support via https://github.com/SpenceKonde/ATTinyCore
 * Modifed code to add support for 10 more sections (30 more leds)

## Spacers

 * Used openscad design in https://github.com/TomKeddie/BendySAO/tree/tomk_files/3rdparty/TomKeddie/spacer for spacers instead of laser cut acrylic.  I found 1.5mm acrylic a little hard to source.

## Stand

 * The stand I was gifted shrank in the dryer so I created a new one using the openscad design in https://github.com/TomKeddie/BendySAO/tree/tomk_files/3rdparty/TomKeddie/stand
